title: The Hawk and Azure Rebirth Mastery
summary: A mastery of rebirth qi that rides rising currents like a hawk and lets a fallen friend rise on the same wind.

title: Treatise of the Twin Cocoon
summary: A treatise on two cocoons of qi spun together so a hurt body rests inside one while the user steps out of the other renewed.

title: The Paired Lifeline Canon
summary: A canon of the cord that binds two lives: strength shared across it and a fallen friend pulled back along it.

title: The Wind-Sworn Reincarnation Mastery
summary: A mastery of oaths that carry a self from one life to the next on the wind without losing its name.

title: Treatise of the Patient Cycle
summary: A treatise on waiting out each turn of the cycle: the user endures the ending and rises at the exact turn of the wheel.

title: The Oath of the Unbroken Wheel
summary: A text of the vow never to break the wheel: every blow taken is turned into force and every ending into a return.
